summary: Tested the public MahaFlow preview API and browser workflows. All four API regression tests passed; browser auth/access-code validation, crowd readings, camera CRUD, dark theme, and mobile overflow checks ran. Fixed three promise/boolean-returning React effects that caused workspace navigation to crash.

ui_bugs.issue: Menu button has no click handler and the sidebar remains display:none at mobile widths, leaving non-overview pages inaccessible on mobile.

integration_issues.issue: Continue calls onEnter with authority data, but App ignores the role argument and always opens Workspace with its developer default. Authority users see the developer dashboard until manually switched.

action_items: Make App persist the role/facility passed from authority code continuation and initialize the workspace as authority.
Implement a mobile navigation drawer/toggle for mobile-menu-button, including close behavior and accessible labeling.
critical_code_review_comments: Supabase Auth, Google OAuth, Storage, and Realtime are intentionally not configured; preview Mongo APIs are MOCKED and must not be treated as production authorization.
The Supabase RLS policies for crowd_readings and crowd_predictions include `or true`, making those policies publicly permissive when the schema is deployed; remove this before production.
Access-code verification is not consumption; the UI continues without calling the backend consume endpoint, so one-time semantics are not enforced by this authority-entry flow.

success_rate.frontend: 80% (core flows pass; authority handoff and mobile menu fail)

seed_data_creation: Created temporary TEST-prefixed access codes and cameras through public preview APIs; camera records were deleted. Access codes remain as generated test records because no cleanup endpoint exists.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Public API CRUD and crowd checks pass. Browser verified auth setup messaging, invalid code handling, workspace rendering after effect fixes, crowd, camera CRUD, dark theme, and no mobile horizontal overflow. Retest role handoff, consume semantics, and mobile drawer after fixes.
rca of the issue: Workspace initially crashed with `destroy is not a function` because Workspace's theme useEffect returned classList.toggle's boolean, and AccessCodes/Cameras passed promise-returning load functions directly to useEffect. These were fixed by using block-bodied effect callbacks. Authority handoff remains broken because App's onEnter callback discards the role argument. Mobile navigation remains unavailable because mobile-menu-button is present without state or handler and .sidebar is hidden under 900px.
